- [LLSU.15.4] Test-mode **runtime machinery** (deterministic clock,
  adapter-mock contract, event-trace primitive, introspection
  queries) ships in v1 because it's how the runtime works
  under test — see [LTES]. This is not an extension;
  authors don't write test-only constructs in rule files.
  User rule tests in v1 are harness-side code that drives
  the runtime in test mode; rule files themselves use only
  base-language forms.
